QuestInfo.name: To the Child Who Forgot My Name
QuestInfo.0:
You defeated the underlings of Hypnos.
In doing so, you learn that Hypnos used #rsmoke and mirrors#k to keep himself out of your memories.
QuestInfo.1: You are now certain why the forest has been rotting away.
QuestInfo.2:
Hypnos used smoke and mirrors to keep himself out of your memories. 
The forest isn't rotting because the Forest Master's asleep. It's because of the #r'eternal rest'#k, Hypnos's cursed brand.
